payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design with dimensional layering. Use: z-index depth (multiple layers), overlapping cards, elevation shadows (4 levels), floating elements, parallax depth, backdrop blur for hierarchy, spatial UI feel.
payload.best_for: Dashboards, card layouts, modals, navigation, product showcases, SaaS interfaces
payload.css_technical_keywords: z-index: 1-4 levels, box-shadow: elevation scale (sm/md/lg/xl), transform: translateZ(), backdrop-filter: blur(), position: relative for stacking, parallax on scroll
payload.do_not_use_for: Print-style layouts, simple blogs, low-end devices, flat design requirements
payload.effects_and_animation: z-index stacking, box-shadow elevation (4 levels), transform: translateZ(), backdrop-filter, parallax
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Layers clearly defined, ☐ Shadows show depth, ☐ Overlaps intentional, ☐ Hierarchy clear, ☐ Performance optimized, ☐ Mobile depth maintained
payload.keywords: Depth, overlapping, z-index, layers, 3D, shadows, elevation, floating, cards, spatial hierarchy
payload.primary_colors: Neutral base (#FFFFFF, #F5F5F5, #E0E0E0) + brand accent for elevated elements
payload.secondary_colors: Shadow variations (sm/md/lg/xl), elevation colors, highlight colors for top layers
